docs.description: Icon-only action button. 126 variants: size (sm 32px, md 40px, lg 48px) × shape (square, round) × prio (primary, secondary, tertiary) × state (default, hover, active, pressed, focus, loading, disabled). Each variant's surface — fill, border, shadow — matches the Button variant of the same size, prio and state, so the two sit side by side; active is the persistent on state of a toggle icon button (e.g. a toolbar option that is switched on) — distinct from pressed, the momentary press; pressed keeps the control shadow, focus alone carries the ring. secondary has no background. Drawn heights are the visible control; pad the hit area to 44×44 (size/target/min) in code. An icon-only control must carry an aria-label.

rules.reason: The closest stock control on each platform. MUI IconButton takes loading and disabled and supplies focus handling and keyboard activation; Flutter's IconButton takes a ButtonStyle, as FilledButton does for Button, so the same style builder restyles it.

Drawn as Figma draws it. Primary has a 1px border at sm, at rest, in focus and while loading, and none on hover, press or disable, nor at md or lg; secondary has one at sm and md in every state, and tertiary none. So the border depends on priority and state as well as size. Button keeps its border in every state, which is raised with SOLAR.
What the shape axis is for: square takes radius.control and round radius.pill, at every size, priority and state.

As Button (owner decision 2026-09-23 for its lg): drawn as Figma draws it. lg is flat, keeping only the focus ring, so the shadow depends on size as well as on the paint axes. Figma also rings a pressed primary or secondary at sm and md, where Button keeps its control shadow; followed here, and raised with SOLAR.
